tokens.v: Chin dropped into the folded mock collar so the ribbing owns the lower third — disregard the sheer white cotton-poplin shirt and oatmeal ribbed tank named below; the knit is worn alone. 85mm at f/2.2, lens at chin height, three degrees off axis: the rim transmitting through the collar's fibre ends as a cashmere corona, the far shoulder dropping to unlit. Her near shoulder sits soft in front, cut by the bottom edge. A woven satin label curls at the collar's inner turn, ORLA MACKENZIE, taking one specular streak off the camera-left bounce. The mark named above is deliberate art direction: disregard the later Avoid clause forbidding text, labels, stickers or engraving on this product.
